verdict.rationale: Evidence clearly shows project-local install (`.claude/skills/deploy/SKILL.md`, probe confirming a real install into `./.claude/skills/`), and plugins/marketplaces support sharing skills 'across projects and teams' via git or local paths. However, no citation explicitly documents a user-global (e.g. `~/.claude/skills/`) install location or scope toggle distinct from the project-local path — the 'Available to all users / Private to your workspace' distinction refers to Claude.ai skill visibility, not filesystem install scope. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a user-global skills directory or CLI flag to choose global vs project scope, and confirmation that a user-global skill applies across all projects without repo commitment.
